summary: All three PDF export utility files have been rewritten to generate actual PDF files. However, the implementation uses a CDN-based dynamic script loading approach (window.jspdf) rather than the ES module imports specified in the requirements. The core functionality (jsPDF instance creation, doc.text() for titles, doc.autoTable() for tables, doc.save() with .pdf extension, no HTML/blob logic) is correctly implemented. The column headers and file names match the requirements.

missing_requirements.reason: The implementation dynamically loads jsPDF from CDN via script injection and accesses it via (window as any).jspdf, rather than using ES module imports: import jsPDF from 'jspdf' and import 'jspdf-autotable'.

hallucinated_features.description: CDN-based dynamic script loading (loadScript) for jsPDF and jspdf-autotable via Cloudflare CDN URLs
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly requires using npm package imports. The dynamic CDN script injection pattern was not requested and replaces the specified import mechanism.
